content:
Alex: Quick sync — Prospect Nimbus asked for a short POC to show they can swap VendorX -> Redwood with minimal client changes. Scope: compatibility shim, prompt parity on 6 templates, billing translation (VendorX 50-token buckets -> our per-token), and security QA (CMK preference + retention).
Priya: I can draft security answers. Key ask: customer-managed KMS, IP allowlist, SOC2, audit logs, and PII redaction options. Note: hosted CMK requires dedicated workspace + approval.
Marc: I'll build the shim prototype. Plan: accept VendorX-shaped payloads (body field `input_text`), headers `X-VendorX-Session` and `X-VendorX-Client`, translate to Redwood API, replay last 3 messages into KV, and return a VendorX-shaped response with `choices[].text` and `usage.total_tokens`.
Alex: Nimbus wants a demo Thu. Can we have runnable artifacts by Wed EOD?
Marc: Wed EOD is tight but doable for a prototype. Example shim curl for demo:
```
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood/compat/vendorx -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token" -H "X-VendorX-Session: sess-09" -d '{"input_text":"Summarize the new plan","max_tokens":80}'
```
Response will include `choices[0].text` and `usage.total_tokens` to help their billing UI.
Priya: On logprobs: returning them is sensitive. Recommend default off; enable behind contract for Dedicated/Private. I'll include this in the security doc.
Alex: Billing sim: Marc, can you run a quick script to convert their sample logs into per-token estimates so we can show cost delta?
Marc: Yes — will run tokenizer diffs for 6 prompts and produce a short table. Expect token variance ~ -5%..+10% depending on prompt.
ops-bot: Reminder: Enabling customer-managed KMS on hosted requires security ops approval. See internal runbook (internal link).
Alex: Action items: Marc -> shim repo + diffs; Priya -> security QA + CMK path; Alex -> demo slides + cost summary. Drop artifacts here when ready. :thumbsup:
